sup:DEMO-F1.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. 

As a family-run foundry, we deeply value our long relationship and take great pride in the dedication of our skilled team. In light of current market conditions, WAGES-METAL rose 3.1 % in twelve months and is 28 % of our cost. 

We are pleased to submit our offer at a price of €52.90 per unit, with a Zahlungsziel 30 days net, a contract term of 12 months, valid from 1 December 2026. Please note that this offer remains valid for 30 days.

We look forward to continuing our trustful cooperation and working together with you.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

Guten Tag,
Thank you for your letter - it is always good to hear from you, and I answer it myself, as I do for all the customers we have known for a long time.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €52.40 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
We checked the notice period data you cited; it holds and we took it into account.
We are willing to accommodate your request for a 24-month contract term to provide you with planning security.
Alternatively, with Zahlungsziel 30 days net and valid from 1 February 2027: €52.10 per unit.
Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms.
Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net.
Our price reflects our costs; our calculation stays internal.
Please give my regards to your colleagues - a good relationship has always mattered more to us than a single order, and I hope it stays that way.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH

move.text:
Guten Tag,

It is always a pleasure to reach out to our long-standing partners from our family foundry. Over the years, we have built a proud tradition of quality and mutual trust together. 

Regarding our current negotiations, I must point out that lowering your offer in each round while repeating the same argument does not bring us closer to an agreement. Furthermore, we have already addressed the notice period data in our previous offers. We hold our offer and expect a realistic step forward from your side. 

Please note that this is our final offer (letztes Angebot), so we kindly ask you to decide. For our Angebot, we propose a price of €52.40 per unit, a Zahlungsziel 60 days net, and a contract term of 24 months, valid from 1 December 2026. This offer stays valid for 7 days.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Andreas Moser
Owner, Demo Gießerei GmbH
